exec $CLI -config valid.json -validate
stdout '^configuration valid$'
! exists outputs
! exec $CLI -config invalid.json -validate
stderr 'unknown mode'
! exec $CLI -config unknown.json -validate
stderr 'unknown field'
! exec $CLI -config valid.json
stderr '\-output is required'
! exec $CLI -config trailing.json -validate
stderr 'trailing data'

exec $CLI -scale -config scale.json -validate
stdout '^configuration valid$'
! exec $CLI -scale -config bad-scale.json -validate
stderr 'scale variable must be request or prefill'
